name: runanywhere-ai-desktop
description: Private, on-device AI for macOS and Windows — chat, reasoning, your own knowledge base, voice, and vision. Nothing leaves your machine.
author: RunAnywhere

scripts.build:node: tsc -p tsconfig.main.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.build.json && node scripts/rename-cjs.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: cross-env RA_DEV=1 npm run build:node && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.start:gpu: npm run build && cross-env RA_GPU=1 electron .
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.selftest: npm run build && cross-env RA_SELFTEST=1 electron .
